_readme: Every prop the game can place with Location.add_prop(key, pos): a billboard sprite from
assets/props/u<n>/<key>/ (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md section 6) standing height_m metres tall whatever its
drawn pixel height. Fields: key (prp_u<n>_<name>, the PixelLab asset key), universe (0-9, must match the
key), height_m (the full drawn height in metres, judged from Reference Bible 1.2 / 1.4 / 5.7 / 11.7 and
common sense; written down in notes when it is not obvious), solid (a collision box sized from the drawn
width), y_offset (metres above the placement point: shelves, windows, pots on counters), anims (optional:
game name -> {match: substring of the PixelLab clip slug, fps, loop, holds}; an unnamed single clip
becomes the looping idle at 6 fps), emission (optional glow strength for lit panels), footprint

(optional: [width, depth] metres overriding the measured box, "posts" for two uprights at the drawn ends so an arch frames a walkable opening, or a list of [width, depth, x_offset] boxes), pending (declared but not delivered: the
labelled placeholder box stands in), request (the Linear issue), notes. Unknown fields are errors.

props.notes: Stone hearth with chimney breast and mantel; mantel at ~1.1 m, so 1.9 m overall (the 1.6 m bible hearth has no chimney). Embers flicker at 6 fps.
Copper pot on a hook with a spoon; the pot body ~0.55 m, the hook above. Hung over the counter against the back wall (y_offset = counter top).
A short stone counter with two porcelain bowls on it (not loose bowls): 0.9 m counter plus its top seen from the low top-down camera.
Family table with a cloth; 0.8 m table plus the foreshortened top, ~1.7 m wide at this height.
Sera's three-legged stool with the ink-burned groove; 0.5 m seat plus the seat's top.
A standing brass tube with a horn at mouth height; Robo's voice.
Wall shelf with copper pots and hanging pans; mounted so the shelf top sits ~2 m up.
Gothic window with a praying figure, 128x192; glows through emission in place of the procedural glass.
Roofed well with a bucket; the roof ridge at 2 m.
Two-wheeled cart with a sack; the sack top at 1.5 m.
Stone-ringed bed gone to moss with white flowers; 0.4 m of stone plus the bed's top from above, so 0.9 m drawn.

A whole gatehouse arch with the iron portcullis inside it (not a loose grille); 4 m to the keystone, fills the courtyard's 4 m opening. Collision is the two posts and the thin grille between them (the grille still closes the gate: the GateDoor interactable in front of it is the way out).
Came back as a complete clocktower spire (256), not a flat face for Robo's pillar; kept as a Truce skyline landmark, not wired to the Atrium pillar.
Verdigris brass arch with a clock at the apex; the eight universe gates of the Atrium ring (the coloured panel sits in its opening).
Stone garden pot with the amber seed glowing in it; the sprout grows above it after the first watering.
Workbench with the gramophone, tools and drawers; the six o'clock gramophone of the Atrium.
The little jester doll; sits on a bench top (y_offset = bench height).
Round stone plinth under the 999 Shield Dummy; 0.8 m drawn (a 0.35 m stone step plus its top from above) so it shows around the doll's feet; the doll stands on it, so no collision of its own.
Came back as a single front arc of rim (one quarter of a pool); a pool needs a top-down disc or kit tiles, so the Atrium keeps its primitive pool. Imported, not placed.
Short wide ladder with a blue cloth (55 x 117 px, so 2.4 m keeps the rungs a believable width); leans on the loft wall as dressing, the ramp stays the way up.
Stone alcove with Robo's brass rest frame; set into the Atrium's north wall.
Linear lists icon/field/pages variants but no PixelLab id; not delivered. The placeholder box stands in until the asset team sends the id.
Striped doll booth with the prizes on its counter (256); Leene Square, placed when that scene is built.
Lucca's two Telepods and their console (256, wide: ~3.3 m across at this height); Leene Square.
The bell in its verdigris frame, the anchor geometry for the U1 guillotine; Leene Square.
Lucca's red bow; a pickup / icon-sized item, not scenery.
Only the seed stage arrived (a glowing seed in moss on the ground); sprout, sapling and ash stages still wanted. Not placed: the Atrium pot carries the seed.
Execution frame cast from the melted bell (172x256); Kuro-Truce square landmark.
Hexagonal iron cage on its chain (168x256); hangs above the Furnace, so no floor collision. Swings at 6 fps.
House-sized clay gear in the shattered pagoda roof (256, ~5 m across); turns at 12 fps, the U2 rate inside U1 (Reference Bible 5.7.2).
Mossy torii with cinnabar flaking (256); ~4.2 m wide at this height. The party walks under it: only the two posts have collision.
A tied stack of surrender petitions; set dressing on tables and steps.
Cinnabar mon banner on a bamboo pole; a thin pole, so no collision.
Bone-white paper lantern, unlit; hangs from eaves (y_offset).
Krona's dripping hip gourd at 64 px; a pickup and a table prop.
Black lacquer stand holding the cobalt nodachi; low and 1.45 m long.
Burned tatami with one clean corner, drawn as a floor mat from above (0.9 m of foreshortened depth); lies flat, walked over.
Charred rack with two katana and a hanging scroll.
Kneeling cushion with tassels.
Came back standing upright through its cloth rather than lying on it; usable as a shrine blade, flagged for a v2 lying flat.
Paper-screen door freshly painted bone white.
The same door peeled: char and soot handprints beneath; swapped for the painted one by the street's flag.
Wooden bucket of white paint with a brush.
Dark timber ladder; leans on walls as dressing.
Stone lantern with a cinnabar paper panel.
A heap of charred roof tiles; debris.
Horned chitin finial fallen from the pagoda roof.
The seed frozen in amber (Reference Bible 5.7.7); a pickup, ~0.4 m across.
